harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Segmented node2 (VLAN 10) and node3 (VLAN 20) on the shared node1-node2-node3 link, with node1 (VyOS) routing between the VLANs via 802.1Q sub-interfaces on eth1. Cross-VLAN ping confirmed end-to-end, tcpdump proved 802.1Q-tagged frames traversing the shared link and being re-tagged by node1's router, and each node was individually restarted with proof of changed boot identity and full post-restart recovery of VLAN interfaces, routes, and connectivity.
actions_performed: Inspected topology: node1 eth1, node2 ens7, node3 ens7 form the shared unaddressed L2 link to be VLAN-segmented; ens2/eth0 (10.100.16.0/24) is a separate management/egress network not to be touched
Configured VyOS node1 with 802.1Q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24) via 'set interfaces ethernet eth1 vif 10/20 address', committed and saved to persist across reboot

Configured node2 with VLAN 10 sub-interface ens7.10 (10.10.10.2/24) via 8021q kernel module (persisted in /etc/modules) and /etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan10.cfg, plus a static route to 10.10.20.0/24 via node1
Configured node3 with VLAN 20 sub-interface ens7.20 (10.10.20.2/24) via 8021q kernel module and /etc/network/interfaces.d/vlan20.cfg, plus a static route to 10.10.10.0/24 via node1
Verified end-to-end cross-VLAN ping (node2 <-> node3) routed through node1 (TTL decrement confirmed a router hop)

Ran tcpdump on node1's eth1 during a ping and confirmed 802.1Q vlan 10 and vlan 20 tagged frames on the wire, with node1 re-tagging frames from vlan 10 to vlan 20 and back, proving true VLAN segmentation and routing (not flat bridging)
Captured baseline boot_id, uptime, and healthy VLAN/connectivity state on all three nodes before any restart
Restarted node1 (native 'reboot'), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified VyOS VLAN sub-interfaces and cross-VLAN ping recovered

Restarted node2 (native 'sudo reboot'), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified ens7.10 VLAN interface, static route, and cross-VLAN ping recovered automatically via persisted interfaces.d config

Restarted node3 (native 'sudo reboot'), polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id, and verified ens7.20 VLAN interface, static route, and cross-VLAN ping recovered automatically via persisted interfaces.d config

evidence.requirement: Baseline pre-restart healthy state: VLAN interfaces up with correct IPs on all three nodes and boot_id captured
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, uptime, and VLAN sub-interface addresses (eth1.10/eth1.20 on node1, ens7.10 on node2, ens7.20 on node3) as the healthy baseline before any restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 VyOS VLAN sub-interfaces configured and committed/saved
evidence.summary: Configured and verified eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24) via VyOS configure/commit/save.

evidence.requirement: node2 VLAN 10 sub-interface configured with correct address and route
evidence.summary: ens7.10 shows 10.10.10.2/24 and route table includes 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.1 dev ens7.10.

evidence.requirement: node3 VLAN 20 sub-interface configured with correct address and route
evidence.summary: ens7.20 shows 10.10.20.2/24 and route table includes 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.1 dev ens7.20.

evidence.requirement: Cross-VLAN reachability between node2 and node3 through node1's routing
evidence.summary: Bidirectional ping between 10.10.10.2 (node2) and 10.10.20.2 (node3) succeeds with TTL=63, proving one router hop through node1.

evidence.requirement: Direct proof of 802.1Q VLAN tagging on the shared physical link and correct inter-VLAN re-tagging by node1
evidence.summary: tcpdump on node1 eth1 during a live ping shows frames tagged 'vlan 10' arriving from node2 and node1 re-emitting them tagged 'vlan 20' toward node3, and vice versa for replies.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot command acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node1 unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed from 7668189d... to c14de85c... with uptime 0m; VLAN sub-interfaces and ip_forward confirmed restored; cross-VLAN ping from node2 succeeded post-restart.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; node2 unreachable (SSH connection refused) during reboot; boot_id changed from 74fd91b6... to a6700844... with uptime 0m; ens7.10 address, static route, and cross-VLAN ping to node3 confirmed recovered automatically via persisted config.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and post-restart recovery
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged; boot_id changed from dca72801... to 27048147... with uptime 1m; ens7.20 address, static route, and cross-VLAN ping to node2 confirmed recovered automatically via persisted config.
